about: Mutants of compiler/check/types, the self-hosted checker's kinds solve and type resolution (capstone S3t). The laws (TestCompilerTypesLawsRun), the seeded property against the Go checker (TestCompilerTypesProperty) or the corpus agreement (TestCompilerTypesAgreeWithChecker) kill each.

mutants.name: union-drops-seen
mutants.rule: A union of two kind variables keeps the positions both have seen.

mutants.name: kind-ignores-receiver-rule
mutants.rule: A function whose first parameter is a local generic type constrains that type's parameters (196m).

mutants.name: receiver-binds-ops
mutants.rule: An operation type's functions are not its methods: they bind none of its parameters.

mutants.name: error-in-type-not-collapsed
mutants.rule: A parameter seen as a type and as an error row is an error row (q47).

mutants.name: constraint-ignored
mutants.from: ks = ks.Append(if g.typed[i] { kindType } else { k })
mutants.rule: A constrained bracket parameter is a type, whatever its positions.

mutants.name: variants-skipped
mutants.rule: An inline variant is a generic record of the union's parameters its fields mention.

mutants.name: variant-takes-every-param
mutants.rule: An inline variant takes only the union's parameters its fields mention.

mutants.name: needs-as-type
mutants.from: walk(st, w, syntax.Item(w.p.Tree, names, i), kindUses)
mutants.to: walk(st, w, syntax.Item(w.p.Tree, names, i), kindType)
mutants.rule: A name in a needs row is a capability-row position.

mutants.name: fails-as-type
mutants.from: walk(st, w, syntax.Item(w.p.Tree, types, i), kindErrors)
mutants.to: walk(st, w, syntax.Item(w.p.Tree, types, i), kindType)
mutants.rule: A name in a fails row is an error-row position.

mutants.name: linkhead-off
mutants.rule: A parameter passed to a local generic type takes that type's parameter's kind.

mutants.name: or-leaves-left-only
mutants.rule: Every leaf of a row argument A | B links to the slot.

mutants.name: own-map-ignored
mutants.rule: The package's own Map makes Map[K, V] its instance.

mutants.name: ext-kinds-ignored
mutants.rule: A foreign generic type's slots give their kinds to the arguments.

mutants.name: include-walked
mutants.rule: An include ..I of an operation type is no type position.

mutants.name: lone-arg-not-walked
mutants.rule: A lone non-parameter argument of a local generic type is walked as a type.

mutants.name: find-without-path-halving
mutants.rule: The kinds solve's finds halve their paths, so its work stays near linear.

mutants.name: unconstrained-defaults-errors
mutants.rule: A parameter no position constrains is a type.

mutants.name: byte-not-uint8
mutants.rule: byte is uint8.

mutants.name: rune-not-int32
mutants.rule: rune is int32.

mutants.name: array-len-dropped
mutants.rule: [N]T keeps its length.

mutants.name: array-as-slice
mutants.rule: [N]T is an array, not a slice.

mutants.name: resolve-own-map-ignored
mutants.rule: The package's own Map hides the map type (L6).

mutants.name: own-mark-dropped
mutants.rule: A parameter's function type written own keeps the mark.

mutants.name: entry-mark-dropped
mutants.from: return if pf.Entry >= 0 { store.TEntry(s, r) } else { r }
mutants.rule: A parameter's function type written entry keeps the mark.

mutants.name: trailing-rows-not-filled
mutants.rule: Trailing row parameters left out of an instance are the empty row.

mutants.name: row-slot-as-type
mutants.to: if false && k == kindErrors || false && k == kindUses {
mutants.rule: An argument in a row slot is a row of its leaves.

mutants.name: alias-not-followed
mutants.rule: A union whose one variant is an existing type is that type (types.md, Unions 7).

mutants.name: tuple-result-dropped
mutants.rule: A tuple result prints as the tuple.

mutants.name: row-sorted-by-text
mutants.from: keyed = keyed.Append(sortKey(s, n, t) + "\t" + Text(s, n, t))
mutants.to: keyed = keyed.Append(Text(s, n, t) + "\t" + Text(s, n, t))
mutants.rule: A row's elements are in the order of their package-qualified keys.

mutants.name: prelude-qualified
mutants.from: func qualified(n Names, name string) string { if n.Pkg == "" { name }
mutants.to: func qualified(n Names, name string) string { if false { name }
mutants.rule: The prelude's types print without a package name.

mutants.name: sig-drops-needs
mutants.from: uses = row(s, e, listIDs(e.p, syntax.NeedsClauseOf(e.p.Tree, n.Value).Names), true)
mutants.to: uses = row(s, e, listIDs(e.p, syntax.NeedsClauseOf(e.p.Tree, n.Value).Names)[0:0], true)
mutants.rule: A signature keeps its capability row.

mutants.name: sig-drops-fails
mutants.from: errs = row(s, e, listIDs(e.p, syntax.ErrorRowOf(e.p.Tree, ty.Value).Types), false)
mutants.to: errs = row(s, e, listIDs(e.p, syntax.ErrorRowOf(e.p.Tree, ty.Value).Types)[0:0], false)
mutants.rule: A signature keeps its error row.

mutants.name: one-param-per-field
mutants.rule: Each name of a parameter group is a parameter.

mutants.name: record-variant-takes-every-param
mutants.rule: An inline variant record's parameters are the union's its fields mention, in order.

mutants.name: fn-slot-kinds-ignored
mutants.rule: A function's parameter passed to a local generic type takes that type's solved slot kind.

mutants.name: fn-conflict-ignored
mutants.rule: A function's parameter passed to a declaration's conflicted parameter resolves to nothing.

mutants.name: fn-constraint-ignored
mutants.from: ks = ks.Append(if typed[i] { kindType } else { class(st.sv.seen[i]) })
mutants.to: ks = ks.Append(if typed[i] && false { kindType } else { class(st.sv.seen[i]) })
mutants.rule: A function's constrained bracket parameter is a type.

mutants.name: conflict-slot-walked-as-conflict
mutants.from: out = out.Append(if k == KindConflict { kindType } else { k })
mutants.rule: A local type's conflicted slot is walked as a type position.

mutants.name: param-own-on-any
mutants.rule: Only a function type is marked own; an own parameter of another type prints bare.

mutants.name: union-row-not-expanded
mutants.rule: A local union in a row stands for its variants.

mutants.name: foreign-union-not-expanded
mutants.rule: Another package's union in a row stands for its variants.

mutants.name: union-member-type-dropped
mutants.rule: A union's member written as an existing type is one of its variants.

mutants.name: wired-no-wrongkind
mutants.rule: fails wired[P] holds WireWrongKind.

mutants.name: wired-param-ignored
mutants.rule: wired[P] is an element of its row.

mutants.name: row-value-as-type
mutants.rule: A row written for a type parameter is the row's value type.

mutants.name: wired-of-type-ignored
mutants.rule: A signature that writes wired[T] of a concrete T is not resolved (both sides print ?).

mutants.name: refined-parse-always-upper
mutants.rule: A lower-case refined type derives parseN.

mutants.name: refined-skipped
mutants.from: out = out.Append(RefinedType{Name: name, Parse: parseName(name), Base: sp})
mutants.to: out = out.Append(RefinedType{Name: name, Parse: parseName(name), Base: sp})[0:0]
mutants.rule: A refined type derives its parse function.

mutants.name: defined-takes-machines
mutants.rule: A machine declaration is no defined type.

mutants.name: import-alias-as-instance
mutants.rule: An Ergo import's alias reads as its target, resolved in its own package.

mutants.name: import-kinds-ignored
mutants.to: if x.Type && len(x.Kinds) > 0 && declOf(deps[imp-1], x.Name) >= 0 && false {
mutants.rule: A local type's slot fed to an Ergo import's generic type takes that parameter's kind from the import's interface.

mutants.name: import-type-printed-local
mutants.rule: Another package's type prints with that package's name.

mutants.name: cycle-heavier-not-kept
mutants.rule: Of two edges between the same parameters the heavier is kept, in the first one's place (mono.go recordInstantiation).

mutants.name: cycle-weight-always-one
mutants.to: weight: if t == q && false { 0 } else { 1 }
mutants.rule: An argument that is the parameter itself adds a weight-0 edge: it does not grow.

mutants.name: cycle-refused-recorded
mutants.from: if !validArgs(c, o, env, p, ks, indices) {
mutants.to: if !validArgs(c, o, env, p, ks, indices) && false {
mutants.rule: An instantiation the checker refuses records no edge (decl.go instantiateExprs returns before recordInstantiation).

mutants.name: cycle-conflict-typed
mutants.from: out = out.Append(k != kindErrors && k != kindUses && k != KindConflict)
mutants.rule: A conflicted parameter resolves to nothing, so no edge leaves it.

mutants.name: cycle-every-edge-reported
mutants.rule: A component is reported once, at its first growing edge.

mutants.name: cycle-arg-qualified
mutants.rule: A diagnostic names the package's own types bare.

mutants.name: cycle-link-skipped
mutants.rule: A function whose first parameter is its receiver type, written with all its parameters, joins them to the type's (mono.go monoLinkSelf).

mutants.name: rowvalue-written-order
mutants.rule: A row value is a set: it prints sorted, as every row does (CK-ROWVALUE-PRINT).

mutants.name: solve-per-function
mutants.origin: wf10 capstone S3t part 4 (lane C S3d2)
mutants.from:
st.sv = solver{parent: []int{}, seen: []int{}, steps: 0}
				let mut vars
mutants.rule: The function kinds share one solve: a solve per function copies the package once per function, so setup grows quadratically.

mutants.name: import-ref-local
mutants.rule: An import reference's Import is the import's place in the import list plus one; 0 names the package's own declaration (S3d12).

mutants.name: import-ref-any-path
mutants.rule: An import's type is a reference into its own package's interface, not another import's type of that name.

mutants.name: parent-decl-past
mutants.to: let d = syntax.Item(p.Tree, decls, if lo+1 < n { lo + 1 } else { lo })
mutants.rule: The declaration that holds a name row is the first whose row is past it, not the one after (S3d13).

mutants.name: gen-side-first
mutants.rule: A generic type's declaration indexes its own gen, not the first (S3d13).

mutants.name: edge-any-target
mutants.rule: An edge is found by its source and its target, not its source alone (S3d13).

mutants.name: visit-no-edges
mutants.from: let out = if v < len(m.byFrom) { m.byFrom[v] } else { []int{} }
mutants.to: let out = if v < 0 { m.byFrom[v] } else { []int{} }
mutants.rule: Tarjan's walk follows each vertex's edges (S3d13).

mutants.name: text-borrow-star
mutants.rule: A borrow prints as the Go checker's Pointer.String does, mut T (MODES-2).

mutants.name: option-one-self-2-open-context-refused
mutants.rule: An expected instance at the enclosing function's type parameters fixes a bare literal's arguments (Some{Value: v} for an Option[E] is Some[E]).

mutants.name: option-one-self-2-foreign-variant-dropped
mutants.rule: A bare variant of an imported generic union (Some of Option) takes the arguments of the union instance its context expects.

mutants.name: option-one-self-2-local-variant-all-params
mutants.rule: A bare inline variant of a local generic union takes only the union arguments its fields mention, in the union's order.

mutants.name: go-qualifier-unresolved
mutants.rule: go is the predeclared qualifier of Go's types: go.Ref[T] and go.Error resolve to the Go checker's go types (examples/admit), not invalid type.

mutants.name: unions-hold-variants
mutants.rule: Only a union is in the table: a variant's members are its union's, and a record's itself.

mutants.name: local-generic-unions-skipped
mutants.rule: A generic union of the package is in the table, its variants templates over its parameters.

mutants.name: foreign-unions-skipped
mutants.rule: The foreign table's unions (the prelude's Option) are in the table: []Option[int]{}.Append(Some{Value: acc}) is typed.
